public class DragonslayerGreatsword extends WeaponItem implements Sellable

    • onPurchase

      public void onPurchase(Player buyer, Actor merchant, GameMap map)
      The effects applied when a player purchases the Dragonslayer Greatsword. Increases the player's max HP by 15 when Dragonslayer Greatsword is purchased. If sold by Sellen, spawns a GoldenBeetle near farmer. If sold by Kale, restores 20 stamina.
      Specified by:
